tools_helpful.evidence: GetForCurrentView() was tagged in the file with a TODO routed to PATTERNS.md#getforcurrentview; the dev-agent found and cited the anchor ('// See PATTERNS.md#getforcurrentview').

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP source reported NativeOrientation / CurrentOrientation / AutoRotationPreferences via the per-view DisplayInformation singleton.
failed_apis.root_cause: GetForCurrentView() throws on WinUI 3 desktop ('GetForCurrentView must be called on a thread associated with a CoreWindow') because there is no CoreWindow. The skill offered only a DPI replacement, so the agent believed orientation had no equivalent and kept the throwing call in a try/catch.
failed_apis.fix: Use Microsoft.Graphics.Display.DisplayInformation.CreateForWindowId(windowId), obtaining windowId from the window HWND: Microsoft.UI.Win32Interop.GetWindowIdFromWindow(WindowNative.GetWindowHandle(App.MainWindow)). This exposes NativeOrientation / CurrentOrientation and works on desktop.

doc_errors.wrong: Maps DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() ONLY to 'XamlRoot.RasterizationScale or Win32 GetDpiForWindow' (DPI only), implying no orientation/display-info replacement exists on desktop.
doc_errors.correct: The Windows App SDK ships Microsoft.Graphics.Display.DisplayInformation with a CreateForWindowId(windowId) factory that provides the SAME members (NativeOrientation, CurrentOrientation, RawDpiX/Y, LogicalDpi, etc.). It is the correct replacement; RasterizationScale/GetDpiForWindow are only the DPI-subset shortcut.

special_apis.special_handling: Must be called on a thread with a running DispatcherQueue; caller must cache the instance and de-register events. Requires WindowId from the window HWND via Microsoft.UI.Win32Interop.GetWindowIdFromWindow.

errors_encountered.error: GetForCurrentView must be called on a thread that is associated with a CoreWindow. / Element not found.
errors_encountered.root_cause: DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() has no CoreWindow on WinUI 3 desktop and throws at runtime; build was clean.
errors_encountered.fix: Replace with DisplayInformation.CreateForWindowId(windowId) (Microsoft.Graphics.Display) instead of catching and printing the exception.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent wrapped DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() in try/catch and printed the raw exception ('DisplayInformation not available on desktop: ...'), leaving NativeOrientation/CurrentOrientation = 'N/A'.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Multiple edits iterating on the same try/catch fallback; agent explicitly noted 'for desktop we need an alternative' but had none.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The skill's getforcurrentview mapping only listed a DPI replacement for DisplayInformation, so the agent concluded orientation had no desktop equivalent and degraded gracefully instead of using the correct API.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — shipped a broken fallback that scored partial (feature output dead).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Correcting the #getforcurrentview table row to point DisplayInformation.GetForCurrentView() at DisplayInformation.CreateForWindowId(windowId) and adding a short code snippet, plus fixing the anchor's 'None ... work' overstatement.
